Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your DayWe are looking for a Data Architect to define, govern, and further develop the architecture of our procurement analytics platform. The role focuses on establishing scalable and reliable data and analytics architectures, including technical standards, data governance frameworks, and architectural guidelines. You will collaborate with external consulting partners, internal data engineering and analytics teams, and procurement stakeholders to ensure high-quality, consistent implementation and long-term sustainability. A key objective is to ensure enterprise procurement data is well-structured, integrated, and governed to support advanced analytics and AI use cases, with a strong focus on Generative AI and Agentic AI for procurement decision-making, automation, and insights.How Youll Make an Impact Define and maintain the architecture and standards for the enterprise data platform. Establish and enforce data governance, development guidelines, and quality standards. Provide architectural oversight for data pipelines, models, and integrations delivered by external consultants.Review and validate implementations to ensure alignment with architectural principles and best practices. Support the creation of reliable data foundations for GenAI and Agentic AI use cases. Promote modern engineering practices, including version control and CI/CD What You Bring Experience in data architecture or senior data engineering within modern cloud data platforms. Strong expertise in SQL, Snowflake, and data modeling frameworks (e.g., dbt).Solid Python skills for data processing, automation, or platform tooling.Experience with API integrations, data streaming architectures, and cloud platforms (preferably AWS).Understanding of SAP data structures in Supply Chain Management divison, SAP MM (SAP FI knowledge is an advantage). Experience establishing data governance frameworks and guiding external delivery teams.About the Team Our Global Functions play a key role in advancing the companys central initiatives and maintaining operational excellence across different groups, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you supply to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external collaborators, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. Our cross-border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Office Siemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the flawless place work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier. Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same! Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Access ongoing professional and personal development while sharpening your mind with our training programs.
